description: Find the contract address of a stock token on Robinhood Chain by ticker or company name, before an agent buys it. Free. Returns Robinhood's tokens with the look-alikes pegproof knows of, then other issuers' listed tokens (pegproof does not check their supply). At most 10 matches: total counts them all and truncated says when the list was cut.

query.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a company name (Nvidia).

name: find_token
title: Find a stock token by ticker or name
